items.title: Apache ActiveMQ CVE-2026-34197 Added to CISA KEV Amid Active Exploitation
items.description: A recently disclosed high-severity security flaw in Apache ActiveMQ Classic has come under active exploitation in the wild, per the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA). items.title: EU’s New Age Verification App Can Be Hacked Within 2 Minutes, Researchers Claim
items.description: The European Commission’s newly launched Digital Age Verification App, unveiled on April 14, 2026, to protect minors from harmful online content, has already been compromised, with UK-based security consultant Paul Moore demonstrating a full authentication bypass in under two minutes.
